##### Project general facts

Damac Hills – Radisson Dubai is a branded hospitality and residential investment project developed by DAMAC Properties in partnership with the internationally recognized Radisson Hotel Group. Located within the DAMAC Hills community in Dubai, the project combines hotel-style luxury living with professionally managed hospitality services. Designed as a premium hotel tower, it offers investors and residents the opportunity to be part of Dubai’s growing tourism and hospitality sector while benefiting from the reputation and operational standards of the Radisson brand.

The development is focused on delivering a full-service hospitality lifestyle with a wide range of comfort and leisure experiences. Residents and guests can enjoy hotel amenities, dining venues, café spaces, and professionally managed services designed to provide convenience and relaxation. Positioned within the established DAMAC Hills community, the tower also benefits from access to surrounding parks, golf facilities, retail outlets, and recreational areas, creating a balanced environment for both short- and long-term stays.

The interiors are designed in a contemporary hospitality style with fully tiled bathrooms and en-suite spaces, while flooring combines carpets and tiles according to the design concept. Kitchens are equipped for practicality and comfort, and all apartments are delivered fully furnished, providing a turnkey luxury hospitality experience aligned with international hotel standards.

##### Location description and benefits

Damac Hills is a prestigious residential community located in the heart of Dubai. Nestled within lush green landscapes and offering a harmonious blend of luxury, comfort, and convenience, this development is a testament to modern urban living.

Residents of Damac Hills have access to a wealth of amenities, including world-class golf courses, fitness centers, swimming pools, and lush parks. The community is designed to provide a holistic living experience where leisure and well-being are paramount.

Situated in close proximity to major road networks, Damac Hills offers easy access to the city's key destinations, including business districts, shopping centers, and entertainment hubs. This central location enhances the overall convenience of living in this vibrant community.
